title: Google says Cloud services in its London region "are experiencing issues", starting Monday at 23:08 PDT; Revolut says its major outage is due to Google Cloud (Bloomberg)
summary: Bloomberg: Google says Cloud services in its London region “are experiencing issues”, starting Monday at 23:08 PDT; Revolut says its major outage is due to Google Cloud — An outage at Google Cloud knocked out online services including digital bank Revolut Ltd. for several hours through Tuesday …
